description: Convert a 3D mesh to COLLADA (.dae), 3MF (.3mf) or OFF (.off). Point clouds cannot be converted. DAE and 3MF record a unit, DAE also its up axis (3MF is always Z up); OFF is unitless and the changes are applied to the vertices.
inputInstructions:
Converts a 3D mesh to COLLADA (.dae), 3MF (.3mf) or OFF (.off). Select the source model as the input file; the converted file is written back to the asset.

A point cloud (an XYZ file, or a PLY with no faces) has no triangles and is refused; convert it to PLY, OBJ, GLB, GLTF or USD instead. 3MF supports the units mm, cm, m, in and ft only (a source in km or yd is written in metres) and is always Z up, so a Y-up source is rotated. DAE keeps one mesh per placement and drops textures; use USD or GLB when textures matter.

With the defaults (auto and keep) the geometry is written as read. To change the unit or axis, set the target. The source unit or axis must then be known: declared by the file or set in Source units and Source up axis.

A model can name other files: USD sublayers, references, payloads and textures, glTF buffers and images, an OBJ material library and its textures, COLLADA images and FBX textures. Each must be a relative path to a file in the same asset. Reference handling sets what is done with them, and Missing references sets what a file that cannot be included does: skip converts without it and says the result is incomplete (conversion-incomplete.json in the run's results), fail stops the run before converting, naming the files.

This pipeline reads no asset or file metadata. Everything it needs comes from the selected file and this template.

tagSchema.label: Output format
tagSchema.description: .dae is COLLADA, .3mf is the 3D-printing format, .off is the plain Object File Format. Defaults to .dae.

tagSchema.label: Source units
tagSchema.description: Unit of the numbers in the source file. auto uses the unit the file declares and applies no scaling to a file that declares none.

tagSchema.label: Target units
tagSchema.description: Unit to scale the geometry to, recorded in DAE and 3MF files. keep leaves the scale unchanged. Any other value needs a known source unit. 3MF does not support km or yd.

tagSchema.label: Source up axis
tagSchema.description: Which axis points up in the source file. auto uses the axis the file declares and assumes none for a file that declares none.

tagSchema.label: Target up axis
tagSchema.description: Which axis points up in the result. keep leaves the orientation unchanged. y or z rotates the geometry and needs a known source up axis. 3MF is always Z up.

tagSchema.label: Reference handling
tagSchema.description: flatten includes every file the model names that is inside the asset in the one converted file. selected-only converts the selected file alone and reports what it names as not included.

tagSchema.label: Missing references
tagSchema.description: What a referenced file that is missing, outside the asset or over a limit does. skip converts without it and reports the result as incomplete; fail stops the run before converting and names the files. A glTF buffer the model cannot load without always fails the run.
